hypotheses.title: Cross-physics edge-normal consensus with matched-budget reallocation
layers: GeoDAWN training_features.tif band 14 tmi
band 13 iso_grav_anom
band 15 depth_to_base_surf
band 17 cond_surf
hypotheses.physical_signature: At a frozen 2-pixel Gaussian scale, co-located magnetic and gravity gradient edges whose edge-normal vectors align, with the stronger independent basement-depth or conductivity edge providing a bounded corroboration term. Reallocate a matched 5% of control dots to eligible 3x3 edge maxima.
hypotheses.why_it_targets_faults_absent_from_USGS_I: Buried basin-bounding/intrabasin faults may juxtapose susceptibility, density, basement depth, or conductivity with little preserved 100 m surface scarp. A multi-physics edge conjunction could expose these boundaries; it cannot by itself distinguish a fault from every lithologic contact.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_art: Local feature primitives include individual gradients, Laplacians, curvature and structure coherence. No reviewed candidate builder uses aligned raw magnetic/gravity edge normals plus a basement/conductivity edge, followed by this matched-budget emission reallocation.
hypotheses.expected_DTI_improvement_rank: 1 among candidates runnable with current files; moderate qualitative upside, magnitude unknown and no numeric forecast.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low–medium; four local bands, one raster-scale feature pass, four spatial folds and matched random controls.
hypotheses.specific_free_official_source: No additional external source. Local inputs are in the owner-mirror training raster; see registry/owner_mirror_input_pins.json.
hypotheses.obtainability_check: All four bands were present in the local owner mirror; descriptions were checked (bands 13, 14, 15, 17) and training_features.tif SHA-256 was recorded in evidence/holdout_h33_6.json. This verifies the mirror bytes only, not organizer provenance.

hypotheses.title: USGS ComCat focal-mechanism orientation prior for active lineaments
layers: USGS ComCat focal-mechanism product: event location plus nodal-plane strike/dip/rake
GeoDAWN tmi_hg (3), tmi_vg (9), det_elev (12), det_elev_slope (19), geod_2ndinv (4), geod_shearrate (7), geod_dilaterate (8)
hypotheses.physical_signature: An orientation-conditioned line filter: reward candidate magnetic/geomorphic lineaments whose azimuth and dip direction are mechanically compatible with nearby, reviewed normal/strike-slip focal mechanisms; do not rasterize earthquake density as a fault label.
hypotheses.why_it_targets_faults_absent_from_USGS_I: Focal mechanisms constrain active seismogenic slip planes from waveform radiation patterns rather than from the surface fault traces compiled in USGS/INGENIOUS. A lineament consistent with those mechanisms but absent from the surface inventory is a candidate for an unmapped or blind structure.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior_art: GEMSDOE32 H61-2 proposed seismicity-density ridge/coherence, and supplied band 16 is earthquake intensity/density. This uses individual event focal-plane geometry, not density or proximity alone.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: medium (API harvesting, duplicate-event/product resolution, uncertainty filters, spatially blocked evaluation)
hypotheses.specific_free_official_source: USGS ANSS ComCat docs https://earthquake.usgs.gov/data/comcat/index.php and FDSN query API https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/
